description: Recurrent PPO, 12-D observation (10-D LOS kinematics + tracking staleness/uncertainty; no privileged target turn-rate). Same observation contract, maneuver library, and tracking chain as the prior two baselines. Fresh from-scratch seed (99999999, never touched by any prior experiment) trained CP1-CP6 with the standard evasive_redesign_config() (zem_t_go_max_s=10, everything else default), then fine-tuned two more checkpoints (CP7-CP8) with the same two additive changes validated on the seed3_pw50 promotion this superseded: (1) RewardConfig.precision_weight=50, precision_scale_m=5 -- a terminal bonus of +50*exp(-closest_approach_m/5) using the true sub-step closest point of approach, added because the existing terminal reward is flat between a 1 m hit and a 9 m near-miss and that flatness is where this lineage's remaining losses to PN concentrate; (2) low-noise fine-tune -- policy action log-std reset to -2.0 (~33 m/s^2 of exploration, down from ~175), learning_rate 5e-5, ent_coef 0 -- to damp the checkpoint-to-checkpoint held-out-eval swing (+/-12 points per seed at the original noise/LR for one checkpoint of training alone). This is the strongest of eight seeds now run through the zem_t_go_max_s=10 config to a precision-term+low-noise CP7/CP8 (see NOTES.md 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-16): promoting it over the immediately-prior seed3_pw50 baseline because it strictly dominates on every metric (higher hit rate, tighter worst-case, larger significance) and was trained as an independent confirmation run, not selected from the same batch the prior promotion came from.

reward_config_deltas_from_default.note: shaping_gamma=1.0, effort_weight=5.0, miss_tanh_scale_m=3000.0 unchanged from evasive_redesign_config() lineage defaults. Fine-tune-only knobs (finetune_log_std=-2.0, learning_rate=5e-5, ent_coef=0.0) affect training dynamics for CP7-CP8 only, not the reward function; full config dump at metadata_path.

held_out_eval_300_case.note: Same 300-case held-out set (build_held_out_cases), same seed stream, as every other eval in this file -- directly comparable case by case.

classical_pn_reference_300_case.note: PN consumes the same estimator output the policy sees (information-matched), not ground truth. Fails structurally on break_turn (41/75) and random_jink (41/75); when it fails, it fails by hundreds to >1000 m.

significance.method: McNemar exact test on the paired per-case outcomes (same 300 cases, same seeds, for both this checkpoint and PN) -- scripts/compare_vs_pn.py.
significance.discordant_pairs: 65 cases this checkpoint hits and PN misses; 17 cases PN hits and this checkpoint misses
significance.note: Strongest result across all eight seeds run through this lineage. Immediately-prior promotion (seed3_pw50 CP8, this file's previous version) scored 83.0% n=300, p=0.001 -- this checkpoint beats it on every axis. Not every seed clears PN under the same treatment: seed2, extended to CP10 with the identical precision+low-noise fine-tune, still trails at 67.7% (p=0.18, not significant either way) -- see NOTES.md 2026-09-16. Unexceptioned across every seed at n=300, before and after this promotion: every RL checkpoint's worst miss stays under 25 m, categorically better than PN's catastrophic-loss tail (up to 1347 m).

supersedes.previous_best_note: Prior baseline (promoted 2026-09-15) was seed3's CP6 fine-tuned to CP8 with the same precision-bonus + low-noise treatment used here: 83.0% n=300, p=0.001 vs PN. Kept for comparison; not deleted.
